author: Goode & Bean, 1896

note.en: A small catshark of the deep slope, 330 to 680 m, known to FishBase from Costa Rica; out of reach of divers and normal handlines.
note.es: Un gatuzo pequeño del talud profundo, de 330 a 680 m, conocido por FishBase en Costa Rica; fuera del alcance de buzos y de los cordeles normales.

evidence: No local record found; FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic (coast not stated)
